_readme: Four HTTP tools for the Vaani agent. Replace <VOICE_TOOL_SECRET> with the value from .secrets.production.txt (never commit it). Map call_id to Vaani's own call/session id variable.

tools.name: lookup_caller
tools.description: Call at the very start of every call. Tells you today's date and whether this number has called recently. If known, greet by first name and do not re-ask anything in already_collected.

phone.description: The caller's phone number, if you have it

tools.name: qualify
tools.description: Call every time you learn something new about the caller's project. Send only facts the caller really said; omit or null anything unknown. The answer's decision tells you exactly what to do next (ask_question, proceed_to_booking, close_gracefully, human_callback, escalate_urgent). Never ask about budget.

deadline_weeks.description: Weeks from today until the caller needs it complete

budget_volunteered_max_inr.description: ONLY if the caller volunteered a figure. Never ask.

evidence.description: Short verbatim caller quotes keyed by criterion number 1-5

tools.name: availability
tools.description: Call ONLY after qualify returns proceed_to_booking. Returns real free consultation slots. Offer only these, reading each label. Never invent times.

tools.name: book
tools.description: Call ONLY after the caller clearly said yes to one exact slot and gave an email address. Say the booking is confirmed only if status is confirmed; otherwise say exactly what the say field says.

slot_id.description: The slot_id of the chosen slot from availability

confirmed.description: true only after the caller explicitly agreed to that exact time
